# Event Media Hub

> Event Media Hub is a private photo and video sharing web app for events. An organiser creates an event and shares a 6-character code or invite link; guests who join can upload photos and videos, like and comment on them, and download the whole gallery as a ZIP file.

Event galleries are private: only signed-in members of an event can see its media, so there is no gallery content to index. The public pages below describe the app.

## Public pages

- [Home]({{ home_url }}): what the app does, how it works and its features
- [Create an account]({{ signup_url }}): sign up to create or join events
- [Log in]({{ login_url }}): sign in to an existing account

## Details

- Supported uploads: JPG, PNG, GIF and WebP photos; MP4, WebM and MOV videos
- Built with Python, Flask and SQLite
- [Source code](https://github.com/takundanyangani/event_media_hub): MIT licensed, by Takunda Nyangani
